verdict.rationale: Zep builds a Context Graph with entities, relations, and custom Pydantic-like entity/edge types (zep-docs-3, zep-docs-33), supports hybrid semantic+BM25 graph search across edges/nodes/episodes (zep-docs-9, zep-docs-10, zep-docs-22), and underlying Graphiti explicitly supports temporal knowledge graphs with fact tracking and provenance enabling multi-hop, entity-centric queries (zep-gh-1, zep-gh-2, zep-docs-52). Community evidence corroborates the deliberate pivot to graph-based memory to solve multi-hop/entity reconciliation problems seen in earlier RAG approaches (zep-comm-1, zep-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent benchmark or hands-on demonstration specifically proving multi-hop question answering accuracy in production.
